descFull: High-performance, differentiable quantum state-vector & tensor network simulator in 100% pure JAX (no classical framework overhead). Accelerated on NVIDIA GPUs and Google Cloud TPU v6e-64/v5e VM clusters up to 37 qubits! Supported by Google's TPU Research Cloud (TRC) program.
